summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its annual general meeting (AGM), including proposed re-election of directors and re-appointment of auditors, along with a proxy form. This is a routine corporate governance filing required of foreign private issuers; it does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. Accordingly, the filing is classified as ordinary and not a special situation.
